question: How can I control which users see beta features in my documentation?
ground_truth: You can control which users see beta features using feature flags powered by LaunchDarkly integration. Configure the feature flag in your docs.yml navigation by adding a feature-flag property to the page (e.g., `feature-flag: beta-features`). You can also use multiple flags with the feature property, where content is shown if any flag is true. For more granular control in MDX files, use the Feature component to conditionally render content based on flag states.
